// 作業フォルダーが変わる前に、保存データの場所を確定する。
var pythonTestdataDir = func() string {
 path,e:=filepath.Abs("../../testdata");if e!=nil {panic(e)};return path
}()

// 保存したブックは一度だけ読み、並行する検査には読み取り専用で渡す。
var pythonSavedBooks = sync.OnceValues(func() (map[string][]byte,error) {
 archive,e:=zip.OpenReader(filepath.Join(pythonTestdataDir,"workbooks.zip"));if e!=nil {return nil,e};defer archive.Close()
 books:=map[string][]byte{}
 for _,f:=range archive.File {r,e:=f.Open();if e!=nil {return nil,e};data,e:=io.ReadAll(r);r.Close();if e!=nil {return nil,e};books[f.Name]=data}
 return books,nil
})

// 版の印は期待値にだけ使う。実際の値が実行中の版と違えば検査は失敗する。
func pythonVersionExpected(value any) any {
 switch x:=value.(type) {
 case string:
  if x=="<VERSION>" {return version.Version};if x=="mdtable <VERSION>\n" {return "mdtable "+version.Version+"\n"}
 case []any:for i:=range x {x[i]=pythonVersionExpected(x[i])}
 case map[string]any:for k:=range x {x[k]=pythonVersionExpected(x[k])}
 }
 return value
}

// 保存した openpyxl 製ブックのパスだけを実行先に合わせる。
func pythonRestoreBook(t *testing.T, key, path, directory string) {
 t.Helper()
 books,e:=pythonSavedBooks();if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};data:=books[key+".xlsx"]
 if data==nil {t.Fatalf("保存したブックがない: %s",key)}
 source,e:=zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data),int64(len(data)));if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 var out bytes.Buffer;target:=zip.NewWriter(&out)
 var escaped bytes.Buffer;_ = xml.EscapeText(&escaped,[]byte(directory))
 for _,f:=range source.File {r,e:=f.Open();if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};b,e:=io.ReadAll(r);r.Close();if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
  if !bytes.Contains(b,[]byte("&lt;DIR&gt;")) {if e=target.Copy(f);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};continue}
  b=bytes.ReplaceAll(b,[]byte("&lt;DIR&gt;"),escaped.Bytes());w,e:=target.Create(f.Name);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};if _,e=w.Write(b);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 };if e=target.Close();e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};if e=os.WriteFile(path,out.Bytes(),0600);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
}

func pythonNormalize(v any, directory string) any {
 data,e:=json.Marshal(v);if e!=nil {panic(e)}
 var result any;if e=json.Unmarshal(data,&result);e!=nil {panic(e)}
 escaped,_:=json.Marshal(directory)
 var normalize func(any)any
 normalize=func(item any)any {
  switch x:=item.(type) {
  case string:
   for _,path:=range []string{string(escaped[1:len(escaped)-1]),directory,filepath.ToSlash(directory)} {x=strings.ReplaceAll(x,path,"<DIR>")}
   x=strings.ReplaceAll(x,`<DIR>\\`,"<DIR>/");return strings.ReplaceAll(x,`<DIR>\`,"<DIR>/")
  case []any:for i:=range x {x[i]=normalize(x[i])}
  case map[string]any:for k:=range x {x[k]=normalize(x[k])}
  };return item
 }
 return normalize(result)
}

func pythonWriteHex(t *testing.T,path,value string) {
 t.Helper();data,e:=hex.DecodeString(value);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};if e=os.WriteFile(path,data,0600);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
}
func pythonReadHex(t *testing.T,path string) string {
 t.Helper();data,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if os.IsNotExist(e) {return ""};if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};return hex.EncodeToString(data)
}

// XML の並びや ZIP のバイト列には依存せず、excelize でブックの性質を読む。
func pythonInspectBook(t *testing.T,path,directory string) any {
 t.Helper()
 f,e:=excelize.OpenFile(path);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};defer f.Close()
 archive,e:=zip.OpenReader(path);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};defer archive.Close()
 parts:=map[string][]byte{}
 for _,p:=range archive.File {r,e:=p.Open();if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};b,e:=io.ReadAll(r);r.Close();if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};parts[p.Name]=b}
 // シートの状態は XML の属性から、セルの値と書式は excelize から読む。
 var wb struct {Sheets []struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`;State string `xml:"state,attr"`} `xml:"sheets>sheet"`}
 if e=xml.Unmarshal(parts["xl/workbook.xml"],&wb);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 names:=[][2]string{};for _,n:=range f.GetDefinedName() {names=append(names,[2]string{n.Name,n.RefersTo})};sort.Slice(names,func(i,j int)bool {return names[i][0]<names[j][0]})
 sheets:=[]any{}
 font:=func(s *excelize.Style) any {
  if s.Font==nil {return []any{nil,nil,false,false,false,nil,nil}}
  p:=s.Font;var color any;if p.Color!="" && p.ColorTheme==nil && p.ColorIndexed==0 {value:=strings.TrimPrefix(p.Color,"#");if len(value)>6 {value=value[len(value)-6:]};color=value}
  var name,size,underline any;if p.Family!="" {name=p.Family};if p.Size!=0 {size=p.Size};if p.Underline!="" {underline=p.Underline}
  return []any{name,size,p.Bold,p.Italic,p.Strike,underline,color}
 }
 align:=func(s *excelize.Style) any {var h,v any;wrap:=false;if s.Alignment!=nil {if s.Alignment.Horizontal!="" {h=s.Alignment.Horizontal};if s.Alignment.Vertical!="" {v=s.Alignment.Vertical};wrap=s.Alignment.WrapText};return []any{h,v,wrap}}
 style:=func(id int)*excelize.Style {v,e:=f.GetStyle(id);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};return v}
 num:=func(s *excelize.Style)string {if s.CustomNumFmt!=nil {return *s.CustomNumFmt};if s.NumFmt==49 {return "@"};return "General"}
 for index,title:=range f.GetSheetList() {
  var ws struct {
   Views []struct {Selected bool `xml:"tabSelected,attr"`} `xml:"sheetViews>sheetView"`
   Cols []struct {Min int `xml:"min,attr"`;Max int `xml:"max,attr"`;Width float64 `xml:"width,attr"`;Custom bool `xml:"customWidth,attr"`;Style int `xml:"style,attr"`} `xml:"cols>col"`
   Rows []struct {Number int `xml:"r,attr"`;Height *float64 `xml:"ht,attr"`;Cells []struct {Ref string `xml:"r,attr"`;Type string `xml:"t,attr"`;Style int `xml:"s,attr"`;Value *string `xml:"v"`;Inline *struct{} `xml:"is"`} `xml:"c"`} `xml:"sheetData>row"`
  }
  if e=xml.Unmarshal(parts[fmt.Sprintf("xl/worksheets/sheet%d.xml",index+1)],&ws);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
  state:="visible";if wb.Sheets[index].State!="" {state=wb.Sheets[index].State}
  selected:=false;for _,v:=range ws.Views {selected=v.Selected}
  var freeze any;panes,e:=f.GetPanes(title);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};if panes.Freeze {freeze=panes.TopLeftCell}
  merges:=[]string{};ms,e:=f.GetMergeCells(title,true);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};for _,m:=range ms {merges=append(merges,m.GetStartAxis()+":"+m.GetEndAxis())};sort.Strings(merges)
  cols:=map[string]any{};rows:=map[string]any{};cells:=map[string]any{}
  for _,c:=range ws.Cols {s:=style(c.Style);for column:=c.Min;column<=c.Max;column++ {letter,_:=excelize.ColumnNumberToName(column);width,e:=f.GetColWidth(title,letter);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};cols[strconv.Itoa(column)]=[]any{width,c.Custom,num(s),font(s),align(s)}}}
  for _,r:=range ws.Rows {
   if r.Height!=nil {height,e:=f.GetRowHeight(title,r.Number);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};rows[strconv.Itoa(r.Number)]=height}
   for _,c:=range r.Cells {
    if c.Style==0 && c.Value==nil && c.Inline==nil {continue}
    id,e:=f.GetCellStyle(title,c.Ref);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};s:=style(id)
    // openpyxl と同じく、結合に隠れる位置は外周の罫線だけを読む。
    column,row,e:=excelize.CellNameToCoordinates(c.Ref);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
    hidden:=false
    for _,merge:=range ms {
     left,top,e:=excelize.CellNameToCoordinates(merge.GetStartAxis());if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};right,bottom,e:=excelize.CellNameToCoordinates(merge.GetEndAxis());if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
     if column<left || column>right || row<top || row>bottom || column==left && row==top {continue}
     anchorID,e:=f.GetCellStyle(title,merge.GetStartAxis());if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};anchor:=style(anchorID);s=style(0);s.Border=nil
     for _,b:=range anchor.Border {if b.Style>0 && (b.Type=="left" && column==left || b.Type=="right" && column==right || b.Type=="top" && row==top || b.Type=="bottom" && row==bottom) {s.Border=append(s.Border,b)}}
     hidden=true;break
    }
    if hidden && len(s.Border)==0 {continue}
    text,e:=f.GetCellValue(title,c.Ref,excelize.Options{RawCellValue:true});if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
    var value any;typ:="n"
    if c.Type=="s" || c.Type=="inlineStr" || c.Type=="str" {value=text;typ="s";if text=="" {value=nil;typ="inlineStr"}} else if c.Value!=nil {n,e:=strconv.ParseFloat(text,64);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};value=n}
    if title=="_mdtable" && c.Ref=="B3" {value="<日時>"}
    var fillType,fillColor any;if s.Fill.Pattern>0 {patterns:=[]string{"none","solid","mediumGray","darkGray","lightGray","darkHorizontal","darkVertical","darkDown","darkUp","darkGrid","darkTrellis","lightHorizontal","lightVertical","lightDown","lightUp","lightGrid","lightTrellis","gray125","gray0625"};fillType=patterns[s.Fill.Pattern];if len(s.Fill.Color)>0 {color:=s.Fill.Color[0];if len(color)>6 {color=color[len(color)-6:]};fillColor=color}}
    borders:=[]any{nil,nil,nil,nil};for _,b:=range s.Border {for i,side:=range []string{"left","right","top","bottom"} {if b.Type==side && b.Style>0 {styles:=[]string{"", "thin","medium","dashed","dotted","thick","double","hair","mediumDashed","dashDot","mediumDashDot","dashDotDot","mediumDashDotDot","slantDashDot"};color:=b.Color;if len(color)>6 {color=color[len(color)-6:]};borders[i]=[]any{styles[b.Style],color}}}}
    var link any;exists,target,e:=f.GetCellHyperLink(title,c.Ref);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};if exists {if strings.HasPrefix(target,"#") || strings.HasPrefix(target,"mdtable_") {link=[]any{nil,strings.TrimPrefix(target,"#")}} else {link=[]any{target,nil}}}
    cells[c.Ref]=map[string]any{"value":value,"type":typ,"num":num(s),"font":font(s),"fill":[]any{fillType,fillColor},"border":borders,"align":align(s),"link":link,"comment":nil}
   }
  }
  sheets=append(sheets,map[string]any{"title":title,"state":state,"selected":selected,"freeze":freeze,"merges":merges,"cols":cols,"rows":rows,"cells":cells})
 }
 return pythonNormalize(map[string]any{"active":f.GetSheetName(f.GetActiveSheetIndex()),"names":names,"sheets":sheets},directory)
}
